value.text: Search found no existing evidence-based closure feature; pmc-874d is historical classifier precedence work. Tracker data only; preserve existing release placement and prepend history. Fixtures will use sanitized SDK/fleet field shapes, including source closure timestamps and GitHub completion wording.
